== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Zykaros, also referred to as Zykaros Prime, is a highly industrialized planet located within the [[Zykaros system]]. The world is characterized by its toxic atmosphere and oceans, making it an unpleasant place for [[inhabitants]] to reside. To maintain habitability, the planet relies on artificial means, including spinning spires located near major cities that purify the air. The waste removed during this process is collected in barrels and sent to the outer edges of the system for treatment. Economically, the planet is a manufacturing hub responsible for producing various goods, most notably parts for starship navigational computers and replicators. It is also the home planet of [[Horizon]]'s [[Pilot]]. Despite its industrial importance, the planet's defensive capabilities are weak and have struggled against invasions by the The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship and [[Karoshan]] fleets. Additionally, Zykaros is the name of a powerful entity capable of manifesting as a massive figure within the planet's clouds, utilizing [[Aetheric symbols]] to create planetary shields and manipulating the atmosphere to interact with starships.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Zykaros is a dark, smoggy planet within a system believed to be the source of [[Solstice]]'s orders. This industrial junkyard, which serves as the home planet for [[Horizon]]'s [[Pilot]], features a toxic atmosphere and oceans purified by twisting spires. The location is inhabited by a [[World Spirit]] that can warp the [[Aether]], manipulate clouds, and shift between a normal humanoid woman and a fifty-foot-tall titan. This entity possesses eyes that leak smoke and a voice capable of making bones tremble, though her unstable form can dissolve into the clouds. Following a global disaster caused by the [[Worldslayer]] strike, the ground and sky of Zykaros are currently tearing themselves apart.}}
